description: The opening loop, played by an agent against a real running game: join, walk to the store, buy the starter pack, confirm the economy and inventory actually changed.

steps.comment: gameplay state survives a run: without a fresh player the second pass starts already owning the pack and fails for the wrong reason
the game must have assigned a plot and starting funds before anything else is meaningful
standing close enough is part of the test: a prompt a player cannot reach is a failure
the purchase must cost currency and grant exactly one card
activating twice must not duplicate the reward
idempotency: the second activation changed nothing
